info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Model By Param1-spec
info.description: The Operational Risk Model Management API enables businesses to modify specific operational risk models identified by unique parameters. This API allows users to patch various attributes of operational risk models, ensuring data stays current and relevant. Typical consumers include risk managers and compliance officers who need real-time updates to reflect changes in organizational risk strategy. This capability enhances the maintenance and accuracy of financial risk assessments in dynamic environments.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific operational risk model identified by its unique ID, enabling you to modify various properties of the model as needed.

requestBody.description: Request body for updating the operational risk model identified by RES-100045. This payload contains the necessary fields to modify existing attributes or add new information relevant to the operational risk model.
